en: An old monochrome illustrated postcard showing a harbor scene with sailing boats moored beside a quay. In the background stands a tall stone clock tower with a pointed roof, surrounded by traditional multi‑story buildings and distant hills under large stylized clouds. At the lower right is a heraldic shield with two towers above wavy lines of water and a scroll bearing the inscription "RIVA".
